method: An independent ungoverned capture: the scripted R5 sequence (list -> search -> read_range + notebook write -> scratch read-back + re-pull -> yield, over the same fixture corpus) run through the real loop with the real adapter and the real Groq connector transport in the path, the loop UNGOVERNED — no evidence_store passed, so its iterations record no CALL_ENTERED and no RESPONSE_EVIDENCE; the adapter stood behind a plain delegate callable, the loop's legacy path, because the loop refuses a seam-publishing callable without a store (INDEX 314/315) — with the provider side replaced by a stub helper substituted through the transport's GROQ_HELPER_PATH env override, which records the exact request body bytes it receives on stdin and returns canned chat-completion responses scripted per call (identify() first, then the five iterations). No provider call was made. Each captured body is attributed with the R5 artifact's own span method (measure_request): the package is parsed out of the captured prompt and re-rendered; the re-render is byte-identical to the capture, so the breakdown is the captured body's own. Components are exact serialized spans of the final body, as in the R5 artifact: retrieved_content = the JSON literal of each tool result's content, counted once (single carriage); case_view_and_assignment = the case span; tool_catalogue = the tools-section dump; provenance_and_dispatch = the view, delta, tool_results, standing-dispatch, bounds and position spans minus the retrieved content literals; remaining_overhead = the remainder (contract, framing, system message, body skeleton). Components sum to the serialized size; residual is stated per request.
